confirmed_findings.detail: The Statement sentence is displayed with source-authored ASCII notation P, Pbar, T^{-n}G, and Pbar(G)=0 rather than rendered mathematical notation. Typeset the measures and inverse-shift event in the existing math syntax; the current tile visibly exposes the raw caret, hyphen, parentheses, and bar-name text.

editorial_candidates.reason: The definition gives an initial distribution, transition matrix, emission matrix, hidden path, observation sequence, and joint mass. A compact time-unrolled diagram could show hidden states z_1,...,z_T with transitions labeled A and observation nodes y_t emitted from z_t with labels B, plus the initial π edge. This is a visualization opportunity; no mathematical defect is implied.

The recurrence explicitly uses layers V_t, allowed edges E_t with weights w_t(u,v), initial values α(v), and prefix maxima D_t(v). A small two- or three-layer trellis could label these quantities and mark the maximizing predecessor relation D_t(v)=max_u D_{t-1}(u)w_t(u,v), with zero for unreachable nodes. It would illustrate the recurrence; the prose proof is complete.
